questions.q: What three things should every planning prompt include?
options: A goal, your constraints and a useful format
A role, a deadline and a list of websites
A budget, a calendar and your account details
A question, a template and a word limit
questions.explain: The lesson's planning formula is goal plus constraints plus format, because a plan is only useful if it fits your real life and the way you'll use it.

questions.q: AI built you a great day-by-day itinerary for a trip. What should you do before booking anything?
options: Book it all right away, since the itinerary is final
Confirm hours, prices and entry rules on official websites
Ask the AI if it's sure, and book if it says yes
Share your card number so the AI can check availability
questions.explain: Opening hours, prices, closures and entry requirements change, so treat the itinerary as a smart first draft and confirm details on official websites.

questions.q: You want AI's help building a monthly budget. What should you share with it?
options: Your full bank statements and login details
Your account numbers so it can track spending
Rounded figures and your spending categories
Nothing at all, since AI can't help with money
questions.explain: Categories and rounded numbers are all AI needs. Never share account numbers, logins or full statements, and double-check the totals with a calculator.
